mode.title: Memory mode
mode.subtitle: How {agent} updates its long-term memory.
mode.copilotHint: {agent} suggests memory updates for you to confirm.

episodic.title: Episodic memory
episodic.subtitle: Save conversation history for future recall.

dashboards.title: Proactive dashboards
dashboards.subtitle: Auto-generate HTML reports from scratchpad output.

actFirst.title: Act first, ask later
actFirst.subtitle: Act on reasonable defaults and state assumptions inline, instead of stopping to ask.

limits.title: Limit how much a task can do
limits.subtitleOn: {agent} stops or asks before going further at the steps, auto-continues and tokens you set below.
limits.subtitleOff: Off: a task runs until it's done, up to a high safety limit where {agent} asks before going further. Turn on to set your own limits.

maxSteps.title: Max steps per task
maxSteps.subtitle: How many actions (running code, reading files, searching) {agent} may take on one request before pausing to check in with you. Raise it so big tasks finish in one go; lower it for a tighter leash on time and cost.

maxContinuations.title: Max auto-continues
maxContinuations.subtitle: When {agent} stops but the work looks unfinished, Cowork sends it back to complete the job — this caps how many times. Raise it for hands-off thoroughness; set 0 to stop after the first attempt (you'll still get a summary of what's missing).

maxTokens.title: Max tokens per task
maxTokens.subtitle: The most tokens {agent} may spend on one request before pausing to check in with you, so a task that gets stuck can't use up a large share of your free allowance or balance without finishing. Raise it if you routinely give it big jobs; lower it to cap what any single request can cost.

jev.title: Fast answers with Jev
jev.subtitle: Jev, MindsHub's decision model, reads each message and the recent conversation to decide whether your chosen model can answer it directly, and checks whether {agent} finished its work. Turn it off to have every message run {agent}.

jevClassify.title: Use Jev for classification
jevClassify.subtitle: Lets {agent} sort many texts into categories, or answer a yes/no question about each one, with Jev, MindsHub's decision model, instead of your chosen model. Faster and cheaper for large batches. Turn it off to label texts with your chosen model.
jevClassify.unavailable: Available only when the coding model runs on MindsHub.

keepAwake.title: Stay awake for scheduled tasks
keepAwake.subtitle: While plugged in, keeps this computer from sleeping when a scheduled task is running or about to run. It can't wake a computer that's already asleep or stop it sleeping when you close the lid.
